verdict.rationale: Token2's open-source fido2-manage is a libfido2-based CLI with an audit/export feature that dumps device info and relying parties to JSON or CSV. It can also list resident passkeys, SSH resident keys and bio templates, so an agent can script read-only state collection for FIDO2. However, the evidence never says the device-info dump includes serial number, firmware version or enabled applications. PIV/OTP state is only managed through GUI tools (Companion App, miniDriver), and nothing shows fleet-scale aggregation. Missing for 10: explicit serial/firmware/enabled-applications fields in the export, programmatic read of PIV/OTP state, documented fleet-wide audit workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
